objective: Close the independently certified orphan-recovery listener postcondition gap by checking every stored provider port with its stored family regardless of providerPid presence.
closed_decisions: providerPort and providerFamily are the sufficient durable inputs to the root-owned providerOwner listener postcondition; providerPid is not a gate for performing the check.
A surviving listener keeps the claimed lease retryable and prevents closed/removal even when providerPid was never persisted.
Do not change identity-bound termination behavior or claim its architecture blocker is resolved.
forbidden_changes: Do not edit files outside the three owned files.
Do not weaken provider ownership, lease transitions, scan fail-closed behavior, untracked-custody retryability, or family validation.
Do not change dependencies, provider/Tinto sources, public MCP behavior, manifests, lockfiles, queue/blocker/release files, git, Jira, or pull requests.

acceptance_criteria.description: Orphan recovery calls providerOwner with claimed.pid, claimed.providerPort, and claimed.providerFamily whenever port/family exist, regardless of providerPid.
A matching or otherwise present listener keeps the lease retryable and prevents closed/removal when providerPid is absent; an absent listener permits existing convergence semantics.
Focused recovery/manager tests, build, and clean real-Tinto READY/first-close-idle probe pass while the identity-bound Windows termination blocker remains explicit.
